label: Gentle Muse · Spooky Season

beats.html:
The worst of it ran
alongside the printing
press and the start of
modern science.

Progress and panic
were happening in
the same rooms.

Somebody you know thinks
we've moved past it.
This is the part they're missing.

contract: Every holiday carries a fact somebody softened. I post the real one before the day arrives.
